assessments.reasoning: SPDX's license-list-data file at commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48 identifies the 3_29_0 creator agent. The connector reports 39205 bytes and SHA-256 26973b132bbd741a569019990d42a09bcb7e30989a3d0368b28f732ffe71bdc1. The rootElement identifies the inspected ListedLicense. Its identifier, name, comment, header and deprecation flag support the claim at the pinned release. Exhibit B's presence in the separate licenseText field is consistent with that reading.

challenge.method: Examined the apparent conflict between the standard entry's Exhibit A-only header and Exhibit B in its full license text. Compared the other ListedLicense header and tested whether absence of an attached Exhibit B would settle compatibility under section 1.5.
challenge.results: Both full bodies reproduce Exhibit B, while only the other entry includes its notice in the standard header. That resolves the apparent conflict. Even where an initial contributor did not attach Exhibit B under section 1.5(a), earlier MPL-only licensing of the kind specified in section 1.5(b) can independently establish incompatibility.

limitations: The finding applies to the identifier in SPDX License List 3.29.0. The standard header field describes a notice case and supplies no project-specific evidence of attachment, licensing history or grant.
Eligibility under MPL section 3.3 depends on the facts of the combination and the status of the Covered Software.
